name: withDateFormatSameInstanceReturnsSame
expected: Returns the exact same BaseSettings instance (this) because _dateFormat == df branch is satisfied.

name: withDateFormatDifferentInstanceReturnsNew
expected: Returns a new BaseSettings instance with the updated DateFormat while all other fields remain identical.

name: withDateFormatNull
expected: Returns a new BaseSettings instance where the date format field is successfully set to null.

name: withDateFormatNullToNull
input: df = null (when current _dateFormat is already null)
expected: Returns the exact same BaseSettings instance (this) because null == null matches.
